items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] My name is Bob Schaffler. They called me Bob Schaffler. My name is Robert L. Schaffler, Robert Lee Schaffler.

ctx.x: well I guess I can close that yes that's fine we certainly enjoyed talking to you

My name is Bob Schaffler. They called me Bob Schaffler. My name is Robert L. Schaffler, Robert Lee Schaffler. What the musician called me, Bob Schaffler. Where were you born? Just when? I was born in Bessie, Tennessee, April the 30th, 1900.
So just about 59 years old now.
